transcript: so an immersive bio jukebox musical starring Jonathan Groff was definitely not on my bingo card but that made me all the more curious to see what this show had in store is it a bold reinvention of a stale formulaic genre? or does it still kinda feel like the rest of its kind? one hand it's pretty obvious from the second the show begins that they're making some strong unexpected choices here and opinions are gonna range widely from person to person about whether these choices are actually enough to set just in time apart from other bio-jukebox musicals for me honestly the answer is not quite I liked the bold choices that they made with the staging and the bookends of the show but I think when you get into like the main body of the book the meat of the show the stuff that you are actually spending the majority of the runtime watching that stuff felt to me like pretty much any other musician biography or at least like not different enough like there definitely are some distinct thematic threads in the show but that's usually the case like there's always some angle that these biographies take about what makes this person tick and like what challenges they're facing but at the end of the day I don't actually think it's that hard to identify a theme in someone's life story and slot it into this formulaic template I think it's a lot harder to tell a person's life story in a way that avoids these formulaic templates altogether now as far as Jonathan Groff I will say that he's giving a very good performance absolutely but aside from the fact that he's just like doing a lot I don't know that this is anything that we didn't already know he could do like the quality of the work is very high but I don't know that it's gonna make you see his talent in a new light and I bring this up because I think your enjoyment of this show will depend a lot on what you want and expect out of it and the baggage that *i* walked into this show with is that I've reached a point where there are few things on planet earth that I find as aggressively boring as the life story of a musician and so if you're in the same boat and you're not in a hurry to see Jonathan Groff on stage again I don't know that you need to rush to see this but I saw the show with someone who is a huge fan of Jonathan Groff and didn't feel that strongly about the biography element one way or another and she had a fantastic time so do with that information what you will
